The '''Font''' was the altar in the middle of the [[Nightsister fortress]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was where the Nightsister [[Witches of Dathomir|witches]], specifically [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] and her coven of spellcasters, would perform their [[Dathomir Magic|magic]].

==History==
[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] was healed on the Font with the [[Water of Life/Legends|Water of Life]] upon returning to the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. The Font was also where the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] was transformed into an avatar of primal anger, to serve in Ventress's plot for revenge on her former Master, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Later, [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] healed the deranged [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] mind on the Font, and also used her magic to graft [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] legs for him.
